content_of_post_to_comment:
I want to cut YouTube out completely, but I have a playlist I listen at night. Does anyone have an alternative for me to still listen to my sleep time playlist?

Thank you for your help and recommendations.
comment: I switched away from YouTube for the same reason and found that separating the listening habit from the app helped. Depending on what you use, you could move the playlist to Spotify, Apple Music, or even a local music player so there’s no temptation to browse. Also worth checking if your sleep playlist is mostly ambient sounds, since dedicated sleep apps have some great options too.
